title: Car Race
moral: Keep trying and you can win.

scenes.summary: Carla and Mark have go-carts and get ready to race.
scenes.text: Carla and Mark have go carts. Carla is number five. Mark is number seven.
scenes.image_prompt: two kids with colorful go-karts getting ready for a race, numbers on carts, bright cartoon style

scenes.summary: Mark suggests racing and the race begins.
scenes.text: Let’s race, says Mark. Get ready, get set, go!
scenes.image_prompt: children starting a go-kart race on a track with starting line, energetic cartoon illustration

scenes.summary: Carla struggles to pass Mark during the race.
scenes.image_prompt: two go-karts racing closely with one trying to overtake, winding track, cartoon style

scenes.summary: Mark hits a bump and Carla takes the lead.
scenes.text: Mark hits a bump. Carla is in the lead.
scenes.image_prompt: one go-kart hitting a bump while another speeds ahead, action moment, colorful cartoon

scenes.summary: Carla wins the race and becomes the star.
scenes.text: Carla wins! She is the star.
scenes.image_prompt: happy girl holding trophy with checkered flags, celebrating victory, bright cartoon style

story: Carla and Mark have go carts. Carla is number five. Mark is number seven. Let’s race, says Mark. Get ready, get set, go! Carla can’t pass Mark. Mark hits a bump. Carla is in the lead. Carla wins! She is the star.
